BrochureContent.Content:
Welcome to 2 Whitegate, Sandyford Village, a boutique luxury, four-bedroom detached A rated family home, perfectly positioned yet discreetly nestled away in the very heart of Sandyford Village, Dublin 18. This exceptional property combines privacy, convenience and architectural elegance in one of South County Dublin’s most desirable locations.

The home has been thoughtfully designed and meticulously crafted with a focus on quality, space and lifestyle. Arrive via the private laneway to generous off-street parking. The property features a private sun terrace that sets the tone for what lies within. The attention to detail continues throughout the property, blending traditional craftsmanship with modern living to create a home of true distinction.

Inside, the spacious light filled accommodation is designed for comfort. The ground floor offers a welcoming entrance hall that flows into a beautiful living room, an open-plan kitchen, dining, and family room, with rear garden access, forms the heart of the home. A separate guest wc, and utility room with direct side access adds further practicality. Every element has been considered to support easy, comfortable living, whether you're hosting, relaxing, or enjoying quiet moments at home.

Upstairs, the first floor reveals three generous double bedrooms, including one with its own en-suite bathroom and a walk-in wardrobe. A sleek family bathroom and a thoughtfully designed landing with storage ensure every need is met. The second floor is home to the spacious master suite, a true retreat, featuring a walk-in wardrobe, luxurious en-suite and excellent storage.

Outside, to the rear you will find the low maintenance landscaped gardens, accessed via dual gated side passages. These secluded outdoor spaces are ideal for children to play safely and for al fresco entertainment.

Ideally located within Sandyford Village with its wide range of local amenities quite literally on your doorstep. Both Stepaside and Dundrum villages are also within easy reach offering a lifestyle filled with convenience and choice. From boutique restaurants to local eateries and shops, everything you need is just a stone's throw away.

For those with a love of the great outdoors, the nearby Dublin and Wicklow Mountains offer endless adventure with hillwalking and mountain biking. Tibradden Wood and Marley Park add to the recreational amenities, along with local clubs for GAA, Golf, Tennis, and Rugby. Families will appreciate the proximity to some of South County Dublin's finest schools including Gaelscoil Thaobh Na Coille in Belarmine, St. Marys National School, Sliabh Rua, St Patricks National School and Rosemont Secondary School.

Public transportation is well catered for with the Luas and regular bus services providing easy access to Dublin City Centre in approximately 30 minutes. The M50 and N11 road networks ensure quick and easy travel throughout Dublin city and its surrounding areas.

Whitegate offers an outstanding opportunity to own brand new, high specification home in this mature residential setting, just moments from local shops, schools, and transport links. This property strikes the perfect balance between contemporary living and timeless design, offering all the space and luxury you deserve.

Viewing is highly recommended.
